title: Extension of a coherent integral filtration across a split biproduct
statement: For a scheme X, a coherent filtration on F, a coherent module A carrying a nonzero coherent integral-ideal pushforward witness, and an isomorphism G ≅ F ⊞ A, the module G has a coherent integral filtration.

source.place: Tag 01YF, final paragraph of lemma-coherent-filter; successor split-sum construction

proof.text: Construct the filtration by composing the old chain with the split inclusion into the biproduct, append the full object, and transport coherence and quotient witnesses across the resulting isomorphisms.
